brief.headline: Cut Dextrose price by 3.0% to match Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG — we're overpaying ₹1.26 Cr a year and they supply 56% of our Dextrose, so we need a second source and a fair price.

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match Sayaji Industries' ₹66.48/KG for Dextrose Anhydrous IP
priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹66.48/KG to Sayaji for the same material. The market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP is ₹60–81/kg (typical ₹66–73/kg), so ₹66.48/KG sits right in the fair band. Closing this gap saves us ₹1.26 Cr a year.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 Days After Receipt terms — no change needed

brief.financialLeverage: Gujarat Ambuja is healthy and big — revenue of ₹6031.59 Cr, they keep ₹6.9 of every ₹100 they sell, and their debt is low at 0.13x equity. Our ₹21.21 Cr spend is just 0.35% of their sales, so we're a small customer to them. They're growing fast at 23.5% a year, which means they want more orders. We can push on price by offering steady volume, but they won't feel much pain if we walk — so lining up Gulshan or Sanstar as a qualified second source is the real lever that makes them move.

evidence.point: We pay ₹68.45/KG to Gujarat Ambuja while Sayaji charges us only ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose
The open market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP is ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg, so our current price is market-fair but Sayaji's is better
Gujarat Ambuja supplies 56% of our Dextrose (₹21.21 Cr) — we're too reliant on one source
They're growing sales fast and want new business
We're a tiny customer to them
evidence.figure: Our ₹21.21 Cr is 0.35% of their ₹6031.59 Cr revenue

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed starch and polyol maker, revenue ₹2359.06 Cr, health score B (62/100) — a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja for dextrose; established supplier in this space

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist making starch and dextrose, revenue ₹821.13 Cr, health C (53/100) — growing capacity, could be a solid second source

risks: Gujarat Ambuja holds 56% of our Dextrose volume — if they dig in or we sour the relationship, we have no approved backup ready today; qualify Gulshan or Sanstar fast
We're only 0.35% of their revenue, so they won't chase our business hard — the price ask works only if they believe we'll shift volume to Sayaji or bring in a second supplier
Their strong financials (revenue ₹6031.59 Cr, net margin 6.9%, low debt 0.13x) mean they can afford to say no — don't bluff without a real alternate lined up
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we're paying ₹68.45/KG when Sayaji gives us ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose — can you match that price so we can keep the volume with you?
